blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createAuthMfaChallenge` method. This belongs to the Auth Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates a multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge for an auth identity with enabled multi-factor authentication (MFA) methods.
